Case 2: Beverly must direct Sarah Crane, an RN floating to the medical-surgical unit, about actions to take in regard to Mr. Adams, who is three days postoperative a total hip arthroplasty and fell during the night shift.
Case 3: Beverly must use good communication and conflict-management skills when responding to Dr. Craig, who is upset about the report he received from Sarah regarding Mr. Adams’ fall.
Case 4: Beverly is attending a quality improvement team meeting. The team is discussing the increase in the rate of client falls on their medical-surgical unit.
